'''Smoulders, the Revenger''' is a [[The Zamorakian Undercity#Minibosses|miniboss]] encountered within [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. It is a re-trained version of [[Smoulders]], who was a miniboss in the elite dungeons [[Dragonkin Laboratory]]. He can be found on the west side of the encampments in front of the portal that leads to [[Zamorak, Lord of Chaos]]. Like other minibosses in the dungeon, he is fully voice-acted.

In Story mode its health is reduced by 50% and its damage output is reduced by 90%. Just like in the Dragonkin Laboratory, he attacks exclusively with magic auto-attacks.
